```{r}
library(shiny)
library(mapview)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)

county_data <- st_read(here("data/county_data.gpkg"))

# check column names first
names(county_data)
```

Run that last line, find the column related to language, then plug it into the app below (replacing `"your_language_column"`):

```{r}
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("County Language Data"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput(
        "var",
        "Choose variable",
        choices = names(county_data)
      )
    ),
    mainPanel(
      leafletOutput("map", height = "700px")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    mapview(
      county_data,
      zcol = input$var,
      layer.name = input$var
    )@map
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
